keys: Experimental Dataset of Id–Iq Setpoint Lookup Tables for an Automotive Permanent Magnet Synchronous Machine

methods: Experimental commissioning at 1200 rpm, about 40 °C winding temperature and 400 V DC, stator limit 500 Arms, power-invariant dq. Original d/q flux and motor torque are supplied as gridded functions of currents. Two derived MTPA/field-weakening reference LUTs use PWM modulation indices 0.8 (sinusoidal) and 0.924 (space vector). For each LUT speed node, compare each of 109 requested torques to the supplied lower/upper envelope and count finite dq setpoints. Estimate torque by linear interpolation on the supplied measurement-based torque surface as a secondary consistency check. Require finite interpolated torque; preserve missing values. Compare to both the raw and envelope-clipped torque request. Each method has 161 speed nodes; power column is speed times the upper torque limit, expressed in kW.
results: All 35,098 cells provide finite current pairs, including 5,196 out-of-envelope SPWM and 4,263 out-of-envelope SVPWM requests. At 16,000 rpm the maximum positive torque is 89.172 Nm and 104.754 Nm respectively. Across all speeds, only 37 out-of-envelope SPWM cells and zero out-of-envelope SVPWM cells return finite interpolated torque from the supplied grid. A finite current pair therefore cannot by itself validate the torque request.
limits: Grid nodes and interpolations are derived machine representations. The 1,200 rpm bench did not execute and measure all tabulated target/speed combinations. Missing interpolated torques include edge and missing grid support. No controller-state trace, commanded/applied voltage pair, independent shaft-torque time series or anti-windup reset. The file currents follow the dataset power-invariant dq convention; 500 Arms is a phase RMS limit.
reproduce: Place the named input files from files[].download into RAW. Run python rwth-ipm.py RAW OUT. Python 3, NumPy 2.3.5, SciPy 1.17.0.
evidence_level: Source files downloaded and parsed; derived summaries reproduced. Third-party source files are linked at the repository of record.
